items.title: Auto-refresh the finding-signals cache in applyDoneMergeEffects after the DONE merge
items.context: In handlers/done-effects.ts applyDoneMergeEffects (~after the bumpVersionOnDoneMerge / runDoneMainPackageBuildAfterMerge calls at ~890-896, post-merge, inside the main write-lock), re-derive + persist the finding-signals cache by calling deriveFindingSignalsFromStore(store, { projectRoot: <root> }) (core/finding-signals.ts) — which writes via learning-store writeFindingSignals → resolveLearningRoot (canonical MAIN cache, post-B-37b3). Run it on EVERY DONE merge (do NOT gate on shouldBuildDoneMainPackageForChangedPaths). Wrap in try/catch: NEVER throw or block the merge; append an advisory mergeLines status line (e.g. "experience cache refreshed (N signals)" or "experience cache refresh skipped: <reason>"). Use the correct root so the cache lands in the main checkout. Do NOT change learning-store.ts (B-37b3 resolver) or version-bump.ts. Keep the effect advisory-only (no gate reads it).
items.userSees: After any `story_advance --phase=DONE` that merges to main, the merge report shows an "experience cache refreshed (N signals)" line, and .lattice/learning/finding-signals.json updatedAt advances to include the just-completed story's findings — no manual `learning_scan` needed.

happy.desc: A DONE merge runs applyDoneMergeEffects which re-derives + persists the finding-signals cache (updatedAt advances) and appends an advisory "experience cache refreshed (N signals)" line.

edge.desc: The refresh runs on EVERY DONE merge (not gated on material-code change).

adversarial.desc: A forced derive/write failure is swallowed (try/catch) — advisory line, the DONE merge still succeeds (never blocked/thrown).
The cache is written to the canonical MAIN checkout (via resolveLearningRoot), not a worktree-local path.

items.title: Smoke: DONE merge auto-refreshes the cache and never breaks the merge
items.context: Add a smoke (packages/main/src/tasks/*-smoke.ts, auto-discovered + npm wiring) that drives a DONE merge for a story carrying a resolved finding and asserts the finding-signals cache is (re)written/updated as part of applyDoneMergeEffects (updatedAt advances and/or the new story's signal appears), without a separate learning_scan. Include a control proving a derive failure is swallowed (advisory line, merge still succeeds). Prefer driving the real applyDoneMergeEffects / the real derive+write path. Bump the printed check count.
items.userSees: node packages/main/dist/tasks/<smoke>.js prints its checks and exits 0; full npm test exits 0 with the new smoke in the chain.

happy.desc: node packages/main/dist/tasks/<auto-refresh smoke>.js exits 0 and reports all checks passed.

edge.desc: Full npm test exits 0 with the new smoke in the chain.

adversarial.desc: The smoke drives the real applyDoneMergeEffects path (not a stub) incl. the never-block failure control.

items.title: Coverage watermark on the cache + learning_validate gap report (detect and recover silently-missed story experience)
items.context: In core/finding-signals.ts deriveFindingSignals(FromStore), record a COVERAGE WATERMARK on the cache (add fields to the FindingSignalsCache type in core/experience-layer-types.ts): coveredStoryCount, coveredFindingCount, coveredThrough (max finding createdAt/resolvedAt folded in). In learning_validate (handlers/learning-validate.ts plus a pure leaf in core/experience-revalidation.ts), compute and report the COVERAGE GAP by comparing the PERSISTED cache watermark (readFindingSignals) against the current store counts (deriveFindingSignalsFromStore current): e.g. "coverage: N/M findings, 0 gap" or "coverage: 438/470 findings, 32 across J stories not yet summarized (cache behind; run learning_scan)". This makes a silently-failed/skipped DONE auto-refresh (CHK-001 never-throw) DETECTABLE; recovery is the existing learning_scan full re-derive which closes the gap. Advisory-only; no gate reads it. Add a smoke: after adding a finding without re-scan, learning_validate reports a non-zero gap; after learning_scan, gap=0.
items.userSees: lattice learning_validate prints a coverage line: normally "coverage: N/N findings, 0 gap"; when a DONE auto-refresh was missed/failed it shows e.g. "coverage: 438/470 findings, 32 not yet summarized (cache behind; run learning_scan)", and after learning_scan it returns to 0 gap.

happy.desc: The cache carries a coverage watermark (coveredStoryCount/coveredFindingCount/coveredThrough); learning_validate prints "coverage: N/N findings, 0 gap" right after a scan.

edge.desc: After adding a finding without re-scan, learning_validate reports a non-zero gap (delta findings/stories not yet summarized); after learning_scan, gap=0.
A cache WITHOUT watermark fields degrades to "coverage: unknown — run learning_scan" (back-compat; learning_validate never crashes).

adversarial.desc: coveredFindingCount is counted with the SAME method as deriveFindingSignalsFromStore, so gap=0 immediately after a scan (no false positive).
